name: Mr. Nothing
description: Has <@ba.kw>reduced</> Redeployment Time, but <@ba.kw>DP Cost</> is not refunded upon retreating; While deployed, <@ba.kw>3 DP</> are consumed every 3 seconds (automatically retreats without sufficient DP)

levels.name: Cautious Retreat
levels.description:
Active Effect: When HP is lower than <@ba.vup>{max_hp_ratio:0%}</>, stops attacking and blocking enemies; Becomes less likely to be targeted by enemies and restores <@ba.vup>{hp_recovery_per_sec_by_max_hp_ratio:0%}</> Max HP every second
Passive Effect: <@ba.rem>Block +1</>;
